events.text: A sudden rain. A stranger offers to share an umbrella. You walk together in silence for a long time.

effects.log: You meet again the next day, by chance. And the next, by less chance.

choices.text: Thank them at the corner and part

effects.log: You think about that walk for years.

events.text: You receive a love letter clearly meant for someone else. It is very beautiful.

choices.text: Deliver it to the right person

effects.log: Two strangers are grateful to you forever.
A pen-friend for life. Strange how things go.

events.text: At a village festival, someone pulls you into the circle dance.

effects.log: You step on every toe. Someone laughs and keeps holding your hand.
You surprise everyone, including yourself.

events.text: You confess your feelings to someone. They are kind, and say no.

effects.log: It hurts. It heals. You are still friends.
You do not forget. You get stronger.

events.text: Someone has been leaving plum blossoms on your windowsill every morning.

ok.log: It is the shy baker's child. You bring them a blossom back.

fail.log: You never find out. The blossoms keep coming.

choices.text: Leave a thank-you note on the sill

effects.log: The note disappears. The blossoms double.

events.text: The person you like is also admired by your rival. Your rival is being very obvious about it.

effects.log: Your honesty wins more than their flowers.
Your rival wins. You are strangely fine with it.

events.text: A walk by the river under a full moon with someone you like. Neither of you wants to go home.

effects.log: You walk until dawn. Something begins.
The river is very loud in the silence. Then they smile.

events.text: It is your anniversary. You forgot. Your spouse did not.

ok.log: A hastily made poem. It works, beautifully.

fail.log: A hastily bought radish. It does not work.

effects.log: Honesty. Also a very cold week.

events.text: At a wedding, your spouse pulls you onto the floor.

effects.log: Years together and still clumsy together. Perfect.
You dance anyway. Everyone cheers.

events.text: You and your spouse argue about how to fold the laundry.

effects.log: Peace, and neatly folded laundry.
War, and badly folded laundry.

events.text: Your spouse wants to see the sea before they get old.

effects.log: A month on the road and a day at the shore you will both remember forever.
Next year becomes the year after. You regret it.

events.text: You find a bundle of old love letters you wrote when you were young. They are very embarrassing.

effects.log: Some things should stay in the past.

choices.text: Read them aloud to your spouse

effects.log: Both of you laugh until you cry.

events.text: A matchmaker introduces you to someone at a teahouse. You both know within a minute that it will not work.

effects.log: A great friendship, born from a failed match.
The matchmaker never finds out what happened. You laugh for a year.

events.text: You save someone from a runaway cart. They look at you in a way that makes your heart stop.

effects.log: A long walk. A second meeting. A third.

choices.text: Leave before they can thank you

effects.log: Mysterious. Also lonely.

events.text: You meet someone gentle who has lost a spouse. You talk until the lamp burns out.

effects.log: Grief shared is lighter. Something gentle begins.
A friend who understands. That is a treasure too.
